description: Guide scientific, technical, and other evidence-backed writing tasks using the Stanford Writing in the Sciences workflow. Use when Codex needs to draft, revise, or review manuscripts, abstracts, review articles, grant sections, specific aims pages, recommendation letters, personal statements, reviewer responses, peer reviews, lay summaries, or science-news style explanations that clearly fit the course. Defer when the request is general business writing, generic documentation, marketing copy, fiction, or another writing task outside the course's scientific and evidence-backed scope.
